build_mega_lm_model: build a MegaLanguageModel instance using MegaLanguageModel.build_model with args and task
build_mega_decoder_layer: build a MegaDecoderLayer via MegaDecoderNoCrossAttn.build_decoder_layer with no cross attention
extract_decoder_features: extract features from prev_output_tokens using MegaDecoderNoCrossAttn.extract_features with incremental state
configure_mega_lm_architecture: configure the base mega_lm architecture defaults via base_lm_architecture on args
analyze_ema_alpha: analyze EMA alpha weights statistics across decoder layers using MegaLanguageModel.analyze_ema
